items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Old Robert Crowder was in the band, Cecil Lewin Irving's nephew.

ctx.x: See. So we rented this bus and we went out on our first tour, and I'll tell you the band was very, very, very, very good. We had a real good time. Old Robert Crowder was in the band, Cecil Lewin Irving's nephew.
